sources.title: What Does Etsy Withhold and Remit to Indian Tax Authorities?
sources.notes: TCS 0.5% on India Payments (RazorPay) and Etsy Payments (Payoneer). TDS 0.1% with PAN or GSTIN; otherwise up to 5%.

notes: TCS and TDS reduce cash payout but are prepaid tax credits (not operating expenses) when correctly attributed to the seller's GSTIN/PAN.
Engine default assumes active GSTIN + tax-compliant PAN (0.1% TDS).
